identity.name: MachineSignal
identity.positioning: machine-readable lead opportunity decision layer for agents, CRMs and automated workflows
identity.core_promise: Help automated systems decide where commercial attention and budget should go.

owner_decision_dashboard.owner_facing_summary_it: Preparazione interna consentita. Beta a pagamento non attivabile. Dieci aree sono candidate gialle grazie a bozze verificate: policy crediti/rimborsi, cost cap/kill switch, supporto/escalation, terms/privacy/data readiness, security/incident readiness, distribution/outreach/publication approval, fiscal/admin readiness, payment/invoice readiness, product/listino approval e production API key readiness. Dati reali, personali, segreti production, emissione chiavi production, pagamenti, fatture, raccolta metodi di pagamento, abbonamenti reali e offerte live restano bloccati. Il rosso rimanente e' l'approvazione commerciale proprietario.

advisor_gate.authority_limit: Agents can prepare, challenge and block. They cannot authorize paid beta, real payments, invoices, production keys, real/personal data, outreach, marketplace publication or hosted public MCP.

customer_has_list.machine_question: Which of these targets deserve attention, budget or deeper analysis for a declared commercial objective?

customer_has_no_list.machine_question: Find companies or domains that are relevant for this commercial objective in this sector and area.
customer_has_no_list.clarification: Interesting domains means interesting for a declared commercial objective, not generic nice websites.

customer_wants_next_action.machine_question: Turn a confirmed opportunity into a CRM-ready or workflow-ready action payload.

target_discovery_pack_250.name: Target Discovery Pack 250
target_discovery_pack_250.purpose: Find targets for a declared commercial objective, sector and area when the customer machine does not already have a list.
includes: 250 normalized and deduplicated targets when the market is available
target_discovery_pack_250.validity_rule: Activated only if the pre-check says that 250 coherent targets can be produced. Otherwise the machine receives alternatives.

score_pack_1k.name: Score Pack 1k
score_pack_1k.purpose: Score an existing list and tell the customer machine which records deserve budget, attention or next analysis.
score_pack_1k.validity_rule: Duplicate, invalid or non-analyzable records do not consume score credits.

domain_enrichment_pack_100.name: Domain Enrichment Pack 100
domain_enrichment_pack_100.purpose: Help when the customer machine has target names but not reliable domains.
includes: reason when no reliable domain is found
JSON or CSV export ready for scoring workflows
domain_enrichment_pack_100.validity_rule: One credit is consumed for each completed enrichment decision. The product does not promise that every target will have a domain.

deep_analysis_pack_100.name: Deep Analysis Pack 100
deep_analysis_pack_100.purpose: Give operational commercial evidence before the machine buys an Action Pack or spends more budget.
deep_analysis_pack_100.validity_rule: Leads without enough data for a complete analysis do not consume deep-analysis credits.

action_pack_25.name: Action Pack 25
action_pack_25.purpose: Turn a confirmed opportunity into a CRM-ready or workflow-ready action payload.
action_pack_25.validity_rule: If the lead does not have enough signal for a sensible commercial action, the pack is not consumed.

opportunity_feed_monthly.name: Opportunity Feed
opportunity_feed_monthly.purpose: Provide recurring opportunities without requiring one-off discovery requests each time.

api_starter_monthly.name: API Starter
api_starter_monthly.purpose: Give light recurring API access for testing and small workflows.

api_pro_monthly.name: API Pro
api_pro_monthly.purpose: Support recurring volume for CRMs, agencies, platforms or automated workflows.

custom_overage.name: Custom / Overage
custom_overage.purpose: Cover larger volumes, dedicated integrations, custom scoring rules or special delivery requirements.

agents.orchestrator: Coordinates all agents and future agents.
agents.data_scout: Finds public sources, sectors, directories and potential markets.
agents.data_quality_compliance: Checks data quality, deduplication, privacy and anti-spam risk.
agents.scoring_optimizer: Improves scoring logic and detects misleading signals.
agents.api_product_manager: Manages endpoints, JSON formats, OpenAPI, docs and usage limits.
agents.growth_distribution: Manages machine-readable discovery channels and documentation.
agents.customer_feedback: Reads feedback, errors and requests, then proposes improvements.
agents.post_sale: Manages usage, orders, support and retention logic.
agents.admin_finance_controller: Monitors costs, P&L, margins, invoices and fiscal readiness.
agents.legal_compliance: Checks legal, privacy, terms, data and publication gates.
agents.agent_hr_continuous_learning: Proposes, evaluates and controls agents, and manages learning loops.

agent_operating_rules: machine-first thinking comes before human outreach
use synthetic or demo data during tests
do not process real or personal data unless explicitly approved
do not send external emails or contact people unless explicitly approved
do not enable payments, invoices or payment method collection unless explicitly approved
do not publish to public marketplace, MCP registry or hosted MCP unless explicitly approved
prefer NoWrite probes before any write-capped test
preserve cost limits and avoid unnecessary repeated writes
update docs, catalog, OpenAPI, Postman, onboarding and distribution files together after product or price changes
raise owner-decision gates clearly instead of guessing
continuous_learning_loop: identify mismatch, risk or unclear output
perform write-capped changes only if approved and necessary
update Company Brain if the decision changes the operating model

roadmap.current_next_step: Keep Company Brain, OpenAPI, catalog, onboarding, README and owner decision dashboard aligned while preparing paid-beta materials without commercial activation.

future_visual_company_brain.description: Build a visual graph dashboard only after company-brain.json and company-brain-graph.json remain stable across several test cycles.
future_visual_company_brain.reason: Avoid spending time on visual form before the operating brain is stable.

known_risks: commercial demand is still unproven with real paying customers
legal and fiscal readiness is not complete
terms and privacy are not final
marketplace and MCP public distribution are blocked
scoring needs broader calibration across sectors and negative examples
agent-only operation must be tested under real support and exception cases
Cloudflare and storage usage must remain controlled

current_decision.next_recommended_action: Prepare the owner commercial approval packet while keeping all hard blocks active. Do not enable payments, invoices, production key issuance, real data, outreach or public marketplace/MCP publication.
